workflow: Run the 16-question diagnostic once if no baseline exists.
Study the lowest diagnostic domain with retrieval-before-reveal cards.
Use Exam + Stretch as the default standard-practice filter.
Commit confidence before answering; prioritize high-confidence misses for repair.
Review why all four options win or lose on every released standard question.
Use Bellringers separately as non-exam-representative integrative drills.
Re-test later rather than immediately repeating the same set.

question_bank_expansion_target.planning_exposure_boundary: This is candidate-planning exposure, not released-bank scope and not evidence of learner mastery.
question_bank_expansion_target.next_bias: Very low Foundation+; heavily Exam-calibrated and Stretch, selected by objective/difficulty gaps rather than raw volume.
question_bank_expansion_target.originality_rule: Questions are authored from public scope/primary standards and audited knowledge, never from exam dumps, live-item recollections, leaked banks, or commercial-question wording/templates.

deployment.activation_fallback: If GitHub Pages has never been enabled for the repository, set Settings > Pages > Build and deployment > Source to GitHub Actions once; the committed workflow then deploys automatically.

precision_boundary: READY_FOR_STUDY means the public ISC2 scope, mapped subtopics, curated precision distinctions, released original scenario bank, metadata, teaching rationales, and site assets are release-organized and audited. The item-level audit currently covers 220 released learner-facing item IDs with zero keyed-answer reversals and no known remaining material factual error. This is not a mathematical guarantee of perpetual infallibility or a guarantee of passing the live adaptive CISSP exam.
known_non_blocking_limitations: Browser-local progress does not sync across devices unless exported manually.
The diagnostic is intentionally a routing signal, not an exam-readiness prediction.
Blueprint subtopic labels are paraphrased; the ISC2 source remains authoritative for exact wording.
The combined released bank still skews easier than the long-term target because the original 56-question baseline contains 37 Foundation+ items.
Batches 002, 003, and 004 remain candidate-only until their automated repository originality/duplicate gate is observed clean and every warning is resolved.
The Pages deployment workflow is committed, but this session could not verify whether the repository's one-time Pages setting was already enabled.
